details:
Expat is a C library for parsing XML documents. The mingw-expat packages provide a port of the Expat library for MinGW.   

Security Fix(es):  

  * libexpat: denial of service via crafted XML input (CVE-2026-45186)
  * expat: Expat: Denial of Service via quadratic complexity in attribute processing (CVE-2026-66046)
  * expat: Expat: Denial of Service via XML external entity parsing (CVE-2026-76641)
  * expat: Expat: XML Injection via Malformed UTF-16 Input (CVE-2026-93990)
  * expat: expat: Information disclosure via heap buffer over-read in XML_ParseBuffer (CVE-2026-77214)
  * expat: expat: Denial of Service via delayed entity amplification detection (CVE-2026-115506)
  * expat: expat: Denial of Service via NULL pointer dereference in external entity parsing (CVE-2026-117610)
  * expat: expat: Denial of Service via integer overflow during XML attribute parsing (CVE-2026-118370)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
